pb-phone.title: Phone receptionist
pb-phone.intro: Prepare the exact client script, review call exports and hand every request to a person.
pb-phone.manual: A verified India provider, owner account, authenticated callbacks and legal review are still needed. Use your own phone forwarding and read the approved script meanwhile.
pb-phone.question: Question
pb-phone.reviewExact: Read the complete script before approving.
pb-phone.held: Held for review. The private transcript is not retained here.
pb-phone.budgetHelp: Use dated provider rates for every leg. Unknown costs are refused. Existing monthly costs remain when you revise the limit.
pb-phone.setBudget: Set or revise the exact budget
pb-phone.importHelp: Copy measured usage and the transcript from a permitted provider export. Enter zero only when that leg was measured as zero. This does not place a call.
pb-phone.utcHelp: Use the export timestamp, for example 2026-10-29T03:00:00.000Z.
pb-phone.error.REQUEST_FAILED: This could not be saved. Check the current details and try again.
pb-phone.error.APPROVAL_STALE: This client order or evidence changed. Open its current setup and review again.
pb-phone.error.CALL_SETUP_REQUIRED: Add the client facts and approve the exact script first.
pb-phone.error.CALL_FACTS_INVALID: Complete the client facts and remove empty rows.
pb-phone.error.CALL_FACTS_HELD: These facts contain private details or instructions that need review.
pb-phone.error.UNPRICED_CALL: Use a complete recent rate table and measured usage for all five legs.
pb-phone.error.CALL_BUDGET_CHANGED: Review the month, currency and pending reservations before changing this budget.
pb-phone.error.CALL_LOG_INVALID: Check the call reference, exact UTC time, month and request details.
pb-phone.error.CALL_ALREADY_IMPORTED: This call was already imported with different evidence. Keep the original.
pb-phone.error.INVALID_AMOUNT: Enter a normal amount in the selected currency.
pb-phone.error.INVALID_VENTURE_REQUEST: Check all fields and use only the requested details.
pb-phone.error.CALL_REQUEST_NOT_FOUND: This request has already changed or been reviewed. Reload the current call.
pb-phone.error.VOICE_PROVIDER_UNVERIFIED: Live calling is planned until provider and legal checks are complete.
pb-phone.error.ORDER_NOT_FOUND: Choose a current open client order.
pb-phone.error.CALL_ORDER_REQUIRED: Choose an order for the receptionist service.
